items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.

HATE Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX allows 55 rush ypg, 3.2 YPC.

HATE Terry McLaurin vs SEA: fewest FP to WRs, 7.9 YPR allowed; WAS lowest implied total (17). Daniels out but Mariota history not tanking fully.
